Each closed length>=2 state had a nonzero relation diagonal; forbidden patterns have zero relation product. The integer prefix adjacency determinant factorizes to (1+z^2)(1-2z+z^3-z^4), and direct periodic images through n=14 matched the avoiding words with singleton correction. The finite automaton closure, unlike sampled enumerations, covers all lengths.
